normalization_policy.geresh: ASCII apostrophe after Hebrew letters is normalized to Hebrew geresh U+05F3 for display/indexing.
normalization_policy.gershayim: ASCII double quote between Hebrew letters is normalized to Hebrew gershayim U+05F4 for display/indexing.
normalization_policy.niqqud: Hebrew combining marks are stripped from normalized_word.
normalization_policy.final_letters: Final kaf/mem/nun/pe/tsadi are normalized to medial forms in normalized_word.
normalization_policy.surface_word: surface_word preserves the displayed source token apart from safe geresh normalization.
